application_status.label: Annual cap of 200 participants
application_status.detail: The Embassy states that up to 200 Austrian citizens may participate per year and applications stop once the issuance limit is reached. Recheck current capacity before applying.

change_control.review_note: Austria ruleset verified against the Embassy's current 18 May 2026 Working Holiday guidance.

summary_facts.label: Participation
summary_facts.value: Up to two one-year Working Holiday stays in a lifetime

summary_facts.label: Application route
summary_facts.value: Embassy of Japan in Vienna only; applicant must appear personally at least once

eligibility_rules.label: Are you an Austrian citizen with an Austrian passport?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: This Working Holiday route is for Austrian citizens.

eligibility_rules.label: Your age at the time you expect to apply
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Austrian Working Holiday age range is 18–30 inclusive at each application.

eligibility_rules.label: Is your primary purpose to holiday in Japan?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Austrian Working Holiday programme is not intended for applicants whose main purpose is employment.

eligibility_rules.label: Will a partner or dependent child accompany you under your Working Holiday route?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Current Austrian guidance says applicants must not be accompanied by partners or children.

eligibility_rules.label: Can you truthfully meet the good-health requirement?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The programme requires applicants to be in good health.

ticket_options.label: I have a return ticket
ticket_options.guidance_note: The Embassy requires adequate funds for the stay but does not publish a fixed numeric minimum on the current Working Holiday page.

ticket_options.label: I need funds to purchase the return ticket
ticket_options.guidance_note: The Embassy requires sufficient funds to purchase the return ticket plus adequate funds for the stay; no fixed numeric minimum is published on the current Working Holiday page.

funds_rule.guidance_note: The current Austrian Working Holiday page requires adequate funds but does not publish a fixed numeric threshold.

jurisdiction.label: Embassy of Japan in Austria — Vienna
jurisdiction.description: Austrian citizens must apply for this Working Holiday visa at the Japanese Embassy in Vienna and cannot use another Japanese embassy. The applicant must appear at the Consular Section at least once.
jurisdiction.ui_help: The Austrian Working Holiday visa must be handled through the Embassy in Vienna.

options.label: I will apply through the Embassy of Japan in Vienna
options.mission_label: Embassy of Japan in Austria — Vienna
options.mission_detail: Documents can initially be submitted personally, by post or through an authorised person, but the applicant must personally appear at least once during the process.

options.label: I plan to apply at another Japanese mission
options.mission_label: Use the Embassy of Japan in Vienna
options.mission_detail: The current Austrian Working Holiday page says Austrian citizens must apply in Vienna and cannot apply at another Japanese embassy.
options.issue: The Austrian Working Holiday visa must be applied for through the Japanese Embassy in Vienna.

document_checklist.title: Valid Austrian passport
document_checklist.description: Provide the valid Austrian passport proving Austrian citizenship.

document_checklist.title: Completed and signed application form
document_checklist.description: Prepare the current Working Holiday application form.

document_checklist.title: Recent 35×45mm photo
document_checklist.description: Provide a passport photo taken within the previous six months.

document_checklist.title: Curriculum Vitae
document_checklist.description: Prepare the current Working Holiday CV form.

document_checklist.title: A4 written reason for applying
document_checklist.description: Prepare the Working Holiday motivation statement in English, German or Japanese; it must not be handwritten.

document_checklist.title: Evidence of sufficient funds
document_checklist.description: Provide evidence that you can finance the Japan stay and, where needed, purchase the return ticket. Credit cards and overdraft facilities do not count as sufficient funds.

document_checklist.title: Pledge or overseas travel insurance
document_checklist.description: Provide the current pledge form or a copy of overseas travel insurance.

preparation_checklist.title: Check the 200-person annual capacity
preparation_checklist.description: Applications stop after the annual issuance limit is reached.

preparation_checklist.title: Plan for at least one personal Embassy visit
preparation_checklist.description: Even where documents are initially posted or submitted through an authorised person, the applicant must appear personally at least once.

preparation_checklist.title: Do not apply more than three months before arrival
preparation_checklist.description: The Embassy says Working Holiday applications can be lodged no earlier than three months before the planned arrival in Japan.

preparation_checklist.title: Run a final Embassy check
preparation_checklist.description: Recheck capacity, submission method and supporting documents before lodging.
